patch_description: Two improvements: (1) Enumerate several lattice topologies (row counts / stagger / spacing) and keep the best after relaxation, rather than one fixed layout. (2) After picking the best layout, run a "contact relaxation" pass: iteratively move each center to equalize the gap to its nearest constraints (neighbors and walls), allowing it to grow its own radius — this directly maximizes sum_radii at convergence rather than only enforcing a uniform target radius. The uniform-radius repulsion tends to leave circles with excess slack near walls and between rows; the local gap-equalization pass recovers that slack.
